title: Etale morphisms become finite etale on a constructible stratification
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $j:U\to X$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $U$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Then there exists a finite partition $X=\coprod_i X_i$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-weil-constructible-subset], forming a stratification [def-constructible-stratification], such that each base change $U_i:=U\times_X X_i\to X_i$ is finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. The fibre products are those of [def-pc-fibre-product]. This is Stacks Project Lemma Tag 03S0 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite).

proof.text: Choose finite affine open covers of U and X using Mathlib Scheme.OpenCover.finiteSubcover on the canonical affine cover, take opensRange of the cover maps, and reindex by Fin using Fintype.equivFin.
Over an affine base apply exists_etale_affine_cover_stratification to the finite affine cover of U. Keep its immersed constructible affine partition and the separatedness of the pullbacks.

For each affine piece, apply exists_etale_separated_stratified_finite to the separated etale quasi-compact pullback. Assemble the resulting local stratifications with exists_stratification_of_stratified_partition, using the predicate that the pullback of j is finite etale. The inverse of pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso identifies the iterated and composite pullback projections, and finite and etale properties are invariant under this isomorphism.

Apply the affine result to the pullback of j to each affine open in the finite cover of X. Compactness follows from quasi-compact base change, and quasi-separatedness from quasi-separated base change. Pullback pasting identifies each local projection with the pullback of j along the composite stratum immersion into X. Apply exists_constructible_stratification_finite_etale_of_affine_local.
